item.title: On the field at the Field of Ares, Ktenikos #104 and Hermnikos #1909 saw each other across
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares, Ktenikos #104 and Hermnikos #1909 saw each other across the spears. Their houses are guest-friends. They lowered their weapons, as Glaukos and Diomedes did, and 121 were spared.
